C-SAFETY-REVIEW-LANES.Name: Per-lane safety review locks — implementation plan
C-SAFETY-REVIEW-LANES.IntentSummary: Split the single repository-wide inference.lock into a short candidate lock plus independent local and non-local review lane locks, so a large remote-bound review no longer blocks every other commit. Keep each lane single-flight, preserve candidate identity and receipt semantics, make the per-chunk debug evidence candidate-scoped and atomic, prove the concurrency contract with gated unit tests, and record the two-lane model in docs/commit-push-safety.md, M-064 and V-M-064.

MustContain.Text: Another repository safety review owns the inference slot
separate local and non-local review lanes
a local review may run while another operation is in its non-local phase

T-001.Title: Split the global lock into candidate, local and non-local locks; make review evidence candidate-scoped

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: review() takes inference-candidate.lock only around make_candidate(), scan() and the final identity check plus receipt write; local_review runs under inference-local.lock and non_local_review under inference-non-local.lock; the single inference.lock and its message are gone.
A blocked acquisition names the busy lane: "owns the local review slot" or "owns the non-local review slot"; the candidate lane names the candidate slot.
Each lane stays single-flight; the two model lanes are never held together; a failed or killed process releases flock normally.
_review_chunk writes last-model-review-<identity>.json through a temporary file plus os.replace, so overlapping reviews leave intact files; no shared last-model-review.json remains.
MARK_SAFETY_OVERRIDE, reviewer_config, reviewer_ownership, prompts, chunking, phases and the completed-review receipt schema are unchanged.

T-002.Title: Prove the lane concurrency contract with gated regressions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: test_local_review_proceeds_while_non_local_is_held: operation A blocks inside non_local_review while operation B completes local_review and writes its receipt.
test_local_reviews_serialize and test_non_local_reviews_serialize: a second acquisition of the same lane fails closed with the lane-specific message before any model call.
A concurrent two-review case proves two candidate-scoped last-model-review files with valid JSON, and an identity-drift case still fails closed with "Candidate changed during review".
The tests use events and threads/processes already available in the standard library; no sleeps longer than 50 ms are used as synchronization.

T-003.Title: Document the two lanes and synchronize M-064 and V-M-064

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: docs/commit-push-safety.md states that commits and pushes use separate local and non-local review lanes, that each lane is single-flight, and that a waiting operation can complete its local phase while another is remote-bound.

M-064 Summary and V-M-064 scenario record the lane locks and the concurrency regression; the file contracts in tools/security_gate.py and tests/security/test_security_gate.py advance their VERSION and CHANGE_SUMMARY per the engineering protocol.
grace lint --path . --assertions current reports zero errors and the current-state documents contain no reference to the removed global lock.

Verification.Command: rg -n "separate local and non-local review lanes" docs/commit-push-safety.md
rg -n "a local review may run while another operation is in its non-local phase" .grace/verification/features.xml

Gates.Gate: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/security -p 'test_*.py' — all security gate cases pass, including the lane-concurrency class.
grace lint --path . --assertions current — zero errors in this change's scope.
grace status --path . --with modules --json — M-064 healthy before handoff.
